meta.source: MTRobotix/MTR-Site src/styles/tokens.css + .claude/skills/mtrobotix-web/SKILL.md; logos from MTRobotix/MTR-SOP logo kit (concept 41)

color.note: Light theme only. Flat: no gradients, glass, glows or extra hues. Colour carries meaning, never decoration.

tokens.name: color-bg-soft
tokens.usage: Alternate sections and image/render backdrops. The only coloured section background allowed.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. 16.9:1 on color-bg.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Leads, labels, kickers, secondary text. 6.3:1 on color-bg.

tokens.name: color-text-faint
tokens.usage: Captions and step numbers only. 3.2:1 on color-bg: below 4.5:1, so use it only at large sizes or for non-essential text (kept as in the source).

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card and frame borders, section dividers.

tokens.name: color-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on secondary buttons and rows.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Brand navy: primary buttons, ROBOTIX in the wordmark, logo dots, dark backgrounds (navy slides, video end cards).

tokens.name: color-brand-red
tokens.usage: Only the MT of the wordmark, the logo's largest dots, and defect red in inspection visuals. Never body text (3.8:1) or decoration.

tokens.name: color-brand-red-on-dark
tokens.usage: Logo red on navy backgrounds (logo kit). Logo only.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: links, stat values, list ticks, focus ring. 6.5:1 on color-bg.

tokens.name: color-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the 'Details coming soon' badge.

tokens.name: color-fail
tokens.usage: Defect / reject in inspection visuals only.

tokens.name: color-wip
tokens.usage: 'Work in progress' badge text only (robot arm).

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Inspection that keeps up with the line
styles.usage: One per page or slide. Web: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw + 1rem, 4.4rem). Sentence case, text-wrap: balance.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, block titles. Web: clamp(1.3rem, 0.6vw + 1.1rem, 1.55rem).

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: Automated inspection system for live production lines.
styles.usage: Product one-liner under a page hero.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat values, in color-accent. Sourced numbers only. Web: clamp(2.1rem, 1.8vw + 1.4rem, 3rem).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We build AI inspection for factories in Canada and Vietnam.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a title, in color-text-muted. Web: clamp(1.1rem, 0.5vw + 1rem, 1.3rem).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: MetriQ checks every part on the line and flags defects before packing.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Small uppercase label above a section title, 1–3 words, color-text-muted. The only all-caps text besides the wordmark.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Reference only: the wordmark is always the logo file, never typed out as a substitute.

spacing.note: Pick the smallest step that separates the things. Inside a component 2–4, between blocks 5–6, between columns 7, section padding 8 (7 on mobile).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Kicker to title, tick list gap, fact row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding; between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section head to content; between blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between columns; section padding on mobile; page hero.

shadow.note: Shadows only for hover and floating elements.

tokens.name: logo-min-width
tokens.usage: Lockup minimum on screen (30 mm in print).

duration.note: Motion = opacity and translate (≤ 12px) only. prefers-reduced-motion turns it all off.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Gap between items of a staggered list.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: The one curve for every transition.
